🚀 We’re Hiring! | Full-Stack Software Engineering Intern

We’re looking for a passionate and motivated Software Engineering Intern to join the team at Coffee Ninja! ☕💻

If you enjoy building things, solving real-world problems, and turning ideas into working products, we’d love to hear from you.

💼 The Opportunity
	•	Position: Software Engineering Intern (Full-Stack)
	•	Duration: 10 Months
	•	Type: Paid Internship
	•	Work Mode: 100% Remote
	•	Location: Sri Lanka 🇱🇰
	•	Tech Stack: Node.js | Next.js | PostgreSQL

🔍 What We’re Looking For
✅ Good understanding of JavaScript and web development fundamentals.
✅ Basic knowledge of Node.js, Next.js, and relational databases.
✅ Familiarity with REST APIs and Git.
✅ Problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.
✅ Someone who takes initiative, enjoys challenges, and isn’t afraid to experiment.

🚀 What You’ll Get
✨ Hands-on experience working on real-world products used by actual customers.
✨ Exposure to the complete software development lifecycle.
✨ Opportunities to contribute to production applications from day one.
✨ Mentorship, technical guidance, and room to grow.
✨ A fully remote, flexible, and collaborative working environment.

We don’t expect you to know everything. We value curiosity, consistency, and the willingness to learn over a long list of technologies on your CV.

📍 Important: This opportunity is exclusively for candidates currently based in Sri Lanka. Applications from candidates residing outside Sri Lanka will not be considered.

📩 Interested?
Send us your CV and GitHub profile (if available) via LinkedIn DM or email us at coffeeninjabyjith@gmail.com.

Know someone who might be a great fit? Tag them below or share this opportunity!

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Planlogic supports Australia’s financial advice industry by helping advisers deliver high-quality, compliant financial plans. With teams across Sri Lanka, India, and the Philippines, our operations rely on secure, high-performing technology systems. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join Planlogic's core tech team. You'll work on building new features, maintaining existing systems, and improving reliability and performance across the stack.

**Core Duties & Responsibilities**

- **Design and build full-stack systems** using React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python and .NET to support Planlogic's operations and client delivery.
- **Develop secure APIs and services** with OAuth2/OpenID Connect authentication, working across PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Cosmos DB and Redis for performant data handling.
- **Build cloud-native architecture** on Azure, using Docker, Terraform and microservices patterns, including integrations with platforms like Xplan.
- **Apply AI technologies** (Azure OpenAI, AI agents, RAG, workflow automation) to internal tools and product features.
- **Maintain code quality and reliabilit**y through code reviews, testing, CI/CD via GitHub and production troubleshooting within ISO 27001 security standards.
- **Collaborate cross-functionally** with product, operations and business teams - translating requirements into technical solutions, documenting systems/APIs and participating in agile ceremonies.

**What We're Looking For:**

- **1–3 years** of professional software engineering experience, strong in React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python and .NET.
- **Data & infrastructure:** PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Cosmos DB, Redis, plus hands-on Azure, Docker, GitHub, Terraform, and modern DevOps (cloud-native, microservices).
- **Security:** solid grasp of auth/API security (OAuth2, OpenID Connect) and data privacy practices, especially given ISO 27001 and sensitive financial data handling.
- **Ways of working:** comfortable in agile, cross-functional teams; strong independent problem-solving with distributed/offshore teams across time zones

**Nice to have:**

- Exposure to AI (Azure OpenAI, AI agents, RAG, workflow automation) is a plus.
- Fintech/wealthtech background or experience integrating financial planning/CRM platforms (e.g. Xplan) is a plus.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - REF7025
jobs.description:
**About Creative Web Technologies:**

Creative Web Technologies Pvt Ltd is a Sri Lankan software organization focused on developing innovative Data and AI solutions, empowering businesses and clients across local and international markets.

**About the role:**
As a data engineer, you will play a vital role in designing, developing, and managing the data architecture and tools required for analysing large data volumes. Collaborating closely with the team and reporting to the project lead, you will be taking initiative in various data engineering aspects such as designing efficient data pipelines to optimizing database performance. Your responsibilities include supporting the team in data architecture design, ETL processes, and database management.

**What you will be doing:**

- Design and implement scalable, high-performance data architectures to meet the organization's data processing and storage needs.
- Collaborate with teams to understand data requirements and design solutions that support analytics, reporting, and machine learning.
- Develop and maintain scalable, and efficient data pipelines for ingesting, processing, and transforming large volumes of data.
- Implement ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to move and transform data between systems.
- Create, modify, and troubleshoot SQL stored procedures to meet functional and performance requirements, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
- Manage and optimize databases, ensuring data integrity, security, and performance.
- Select and implement appropriate database technologies based on project requirements.
- Work with big data technologies to process and analyze large datasets.
- Implement distributed computing solutions for handling big data challenges.
- Establish and enforce data quality standards and best practices.
- Implement data governance policies to ensure compliance and security.
- Deploy and manage infrastructure for data storage, processing, and retrieval.
- Monitor and optimize the performance of data systems.
- Co-operate with teams, including data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders, to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
- Communicate technical concepts and solutions to non-technical stakeholders.

#### **What we expect:**

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- 2-3 years of proven experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.
- Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala.
- Experience with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL), data warehousing, and big data technologies.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure).
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
